notes.author: pete
notes.text: Dennis comes on his own. His wife attends a church near her mother's care home, and he is always glad to talk about them both.
notes.testPurpose: A Personal Note alert on an adult.

notes.author: ted
notes.text: Dennis asked about a group with other retirees. Invited him to Pastor Pete's Book of John group in the Fosters' home. {@pete}, he may come this week.

replies.author: pete
replies.text: He came and fit right in. He already volunteered to bring snacks.
